hypothesis: Directional semantic modes must retain the label-free base canonical field L2 amplitude because the frozen nonlinear SurfaceRegion readout is not invariant to feature scale.

method.amplitude: per-primitive L2 norm decoded by the frozen Field-C base field
method.carrier: one shared 256-dimensional affine basis fitted to base-field centers and amplitude-restored prototypes
method.query_pooling: no pooling is permitted before both standard-mode frozen sentinels are measured

sentinel.first_measurement: each mode separately; no label-selected mixing
sentinel.stop_rule: Do not expand if gauge-preserving modes fail the label-free capacity gate or both frozen single-mode sentinels remain materially below Field-C.
